resources.string: App info → Battery usage: turn on “Allow foreground activity”, “Allow background activity” and “Auto launch”
Lock LeoSync in the recent apps overview (long-press the card → Lock)
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: add LeoSync to “Never sleeping apps”
App info → Battery saver: choose “No restrictions”
Lock LeoSync in the recent apps overview
Settings → Battery → App launch: set LeoSync to “Manage manually” and turn on all three switches
